hadith.title: In Light of Hadith
hadith.subtitle: The sayings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) about Qard al-Hasan

hadith1.text: Whoever takes people's wealth intending to repay it, Allah will repay it on his behalf. And whoever takes it intending to waste it, Allah will destroy him.

hadith2.text: Whoever takes a loan and does not intend to repay it, will meet Allah as a thief.

hadith3.text: All the sins of a martyr are forgiven except debt.

quran.title: In Light of Quran
quran.subtitle: Allah's words about interest and lending

ayah1.text: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward.

ayah2.text: O you who have believed, fear Allah and give up what remains of interest, if you should be believers.

ayah3.text: Those who consume interest cannot stand on the Day of Resurrection except as one stands who is being beaten by Satan into insanity. That is because they say, 'Trade is just like interest.' But Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest.
